hero.title: The Sovereign Standard of Canine Living
hero.subtitle: Curated for the heirs of elegance and their discerning patrons.

features.title: Rare Acquisitions
features.description: Discover the pinnacle of canine opulence with exclusive pieces from The Vault.

features.title: Couture Tailoring
features.description: A masterclass in material selection and high-fashion aesthetics for the refined pet.

features.title: Architectural Rest
features.description: Furniture-grade masterpieces designed to complement the most sophisticated interiors.

the_wardrobe.title: The Wardrobe
the_wardrobe.description: Editorial excellence meets everyday function. Explore our couture range of outerwear, from classic trench coats to high-fashion gillets, meticulously detailed to reflect a life lived beautifully.

the_vault.title: The Vault
the_vault.description: The inner circle of canine luxury. Encrusted with shimmering details and radiant finishes, these rare acquisitions are reserved for the dog who demands to be the best-dressed in the room.

the_penthouse_suite.title: The Penthouse Suite
the_penthouse_suite.description: Luxury living starts at floor level. Our furniture-grade loungers and premium crates provide an orthopedic sanctuary that integrates seamlessly with modern, high-end decor.

the_getaway.title: The Getaway
the_getaway.description: Refining the journey for the modern traveler. From airline-approved totes to designer car seat covers, ensure your companion travels in a sanctuary of style on every adventure.

bowls_kitchen.title: Bowls & Kitchen
bowls_kitchen.description: Every meal is a celebrated event. Elevate the daily ritual of dining to an epicurean standard with marble-inspired finishes, laser-etched chalices, and smart hydration sanctuaries.

the_spa.title: The Spa
the_spa.description: A ritual of restoration. Transform routine maintenance into a five-star sensory experience with professional-grade tools and aromatherapy diffusers designed for the well-groomed companion.

the_accessory_bar.title: The Accessory Bar
the_accessory_bar.description: The finishing touch of a life lived beautifully. Define your pet's presence with artisan-engraved collars, silk bandanas, and signature gold-toned leads.

the_sleep_suite.title: The Sleep Suite
the_sleep_suite.description: Indulge in the tranquility of the night. Silk-lined blankets, orthopedic mattresses, and restorative sleep masks designed for the ultimate beauty rest.
